nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: You awaken in an unfamiliar room. The smell of ale and woodsmoke fills the air. Through a dusty window, pale morning light filters in.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Your head throbs with a dull ache. You remember... nothing. Only fragments of darkness and whispered words.
A knock at the door startles you.

choices.text: Ignore it and search the room

nodes.speaker: Innkeeper Mary
nodes.text: Good morning, traveler! I hope you slept well. Breakfast is ready downstairs if you're hungry.

choices.text: Thank her and head to breakfast
Ask if she knows who you are

nodes.label: search_room
nodes.text: You quickly search the small room. On a nightstand, you find a small pouch of coins and a worn journal.

actions.title: Found Items
actions.message: Gold pouch and journal added to inventory

nodes.text: The knock comes again, more insistent this time.

nodes.label: hide_sequence
nodes.text: You dive under the bed in a moment of panic. Dust fills your nostrils.
The door creaks open. You see a pair of worn boots approach.
nodes.speaker: Innkeeper Mary
Innkeeper Mary
nodes.text: ...Are you under the bed? I can see your feet, dear.
Well, this is embarrassing. You crawl out, covered in dust bunnies.

nodes.label: mary_exposition
nodes.speaker: Innkeeper Mary
nodes.text: This is the Weary Traveler Inn, at the Crossroads. We get all sorts passing through - merchants, adventurers, and... others.

nodes.speaker: Innkeeper Mary
nodes.text: The town square is just outside. There's a blacksmith, temple, and market if you need supplies.

variants.text: The town square is just outside. I notice you have a keen look about you - the temple has a library you might find interesting.

nodes.label: mary_dangers
nodes.speaker: Innkeeper Mary
nodes.text: The Darkwood Forest to the east has grown... strange lately. Folk have gone missing. And there are rumors of bandits on the north road.

nodes.speaker: Innkeeper Mary
nodes.text: Best be careful if you venture out there. Now, come get some breakfast!

nodes.label: mary_identity
nodes.speaker: Innkeeper Mary
nodes.text: You came in last night during the storm. Paid for the room in advance and went straight to bed. Didn't give a name.

nodes.speaker: Innkeeper Mary
nodes.text: Are you... alright, traveler? You look like you've seen a ghost.

variants.text: Are you... alright, traveler? There's something different about you. A darkness in your eyes.

nodes.label: mary_concerned
nodes.speaker: Innkeeper Mary
nodes.text: If you need to talk, I'm here. Come, let's get some food in you. Everything seems better after breakfast.

nodes.label: mary_brushoff
nodes.speaker: Innkeeper Mary
nodes.text: Well, it's not my business to pry. Breakfast is downstairs whenever you're ready.
The common room is warm and inviting. A fire crackles in the hearth, and the smell of bacon fills the air.
A few other patrons are scattered about - a merchant counting coins, a hooded figure in the corner, and a bard tuning his lute.

nodes.label: breakfast_alone
nodes.text: You find a quiet corner and settle in. Mary brings you a plate of eggs, bacon, and fresh bread.
As you eat, you overhear snippets of conversation...

nodes.label: breakfast_bard
nodes.speaker: Bard Tom
nodes.text: Ah, a fellow early riser! Care to hear a song while you break your fast?

nodes.label: bard_song
nodes.speaker: Bard Tom
nodes.text: He plays a haunting melody about a fallen hero and lost love. Despite yourself, you feel moved.
The music seems to ease your troubled mind.

nodes.label: bard_news
nodes.speaker: Bard Tom
nodes.text: Trouble in the Darkwood, strange lights at night. The old witch's hut has been smoking again. And...

nodes.speaker: Bard Tom
nodes.text: He leans closer. 'The temple priests are worried. They speak of corruption spreading. Be careful, friend.'

nodes.label: breakfast_mysterious
nodes.text: The hooded figure watches you approach. You feel an unsettling chill as you draw near.

nodes.label: mysterious_success
nodes.speaker: Hooded Figure
nodes.text: 'You have a strong will,' a female voice says. 'That will serve you well in the days to come.'

nodes.speaker: Hooded Figure
nodes.text: 'Seek the temple. Ask about the corruption. You may find... answers.' She rises and leaves without another word.

nodes.label: mysterious_failure
nodes.text: As you approach, a wave of dizziness washes over you. When your vision clears, the figure is gone.
You shake your head and return to your meal, but the unease lingers.
After finishing your meal, you feel ready to face the day. The world awaits.
